svg.title: How CorvinOS picks a model for every turn
svg.desc: Pins win; otherwise the chat fast-path sends conversation to Haiku, the rule-tree classifier picks Haiku, Sonnet or Opus for work, and Sonnet is the default when nothing decides.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One resolver picks the model for every turn

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Same function for the console chat and every chat bridge — evaluated top to bottom, first answer wins.
